d: India vs New Zealand 1st Test: Mohammed Siraj's omission from India's playing XI against New Zealand has left many wondering what exactly went into the selection call. After his heroics in the India vs England Test series at The Oval, why has one of India's most trusted fast bowlers been left out despite conditions that appeared to suit him? Rupha Ramani looks at India's team selection, the focus on batting depth and the questions surrounding Siraj's place in the Test side.
